additional_info.subject: RE: ID0395792-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R9 170002620] Incorrect configuration CRM:00642001857
additional_info.body:
Hello Domenico,
Hope you are doing great.
As per reported issue, Incorrect configuration from the factory in PLC Configuration > Globals > Surge Protection was set to "2 -Extended Surge Protection, even though the hardware is set for "1 -Basic Surge Protection". And Malfunction during dispenser commissioning noticed. Miscellaneous Dispenser Error Flags active.
As you have stated ,this ticket Opening of the documentation purposes only, problem has been already fixed.
If it's acceptable to you, may we proceed to close this case?
Thank you
Best Regards
eMobility Tech Support Team - Mohini
Please do not change the subject of this Email when replying to it.
